awk.description: Pattern scanning and processing language. Powerful for text processing.

fields.label: Field separator
fields.tooltip: e.g., ':' or ',' for CSV.

fields.label: Pattern/Action
fields.tooltip: e.g., {print $1}

fields.label: File
fields.tooltip: Input file. Leave blank for stdin.

find.description: Search for files in a directory hierarchy based on criteria.

fields.label: Starting Path
fields.tooltip: The directory to start searching from (e.g., /var/www or .).

fields.label: Name pattern
fields.tooltip: Use wildcards, e.g., *.log or config.* Mutually exclusive with -iname.

fields.label: Case insensitive (-iname)
fields.tooltip: Like -name but case insensitive. Mutually exclusive with -name.

fields.label: Size (Range 1)
fields.tooltip:
[+/-] [number] [unit] 
Unit: c (bytes), k (KB), M (MB), G (GB), T (TB). e.g., +100M

fields.label: Size (Range 2)
fields.tooltip:
[+/-] [number] [unit] 
Unit: c (bytes), k (KB), M (MB), G (GB), T (TB). e.g., -1G

fields.label: Modified Days (Range 1)
fields.tooltip: Days ago. +7 (older than 7 days), -30 (newer than 30 days).

fields.label: Modified Days (Range 2)
fields.tooltip: Days ago. e.g., -30 (newer than 30 days)

fields.label: Modified Minutes (Range 1)
fields.tooltip: Minutes ago. +60 (older than 60 min), -15 (newer than 15 min).

fields.label: Modified Minutes (Range 2)
fields.tooltip: Minutes ago. e.g., -15 (newer than 15 min)

fields.label: Date Modified (Timestamp)
fields.tooltip:
Select a date. 
	Leave dropdown blank to find files modified *after* this date. 
	Select '!' to find files modified *before or on* this date.

fields.label: Owned by User
fields.tooltip: Find files owned by this user, e.g., root

fields.label: Owned by Group
fields.tooltip: Find files owned by this group, e.g., www-data

fields.label: Permissions
fields.tooltip:
Enter Octal (e.g., 755) or Symbolic (e.g., u=s). 
Use dropdown: 
	(exact) '755' 
	(at least) '-4000' (SetUID) 
	(any of) '/222' (any write bit).

fields.label: Execute command on results
fields.tooltip: e.g., rm {} \; (**use with caution!**)

fields.label: Suppress Errors (2>/dev/null)
fields.tooltip: Redirects error messages so they are not displayed.

grep.description: Search for PATTERNs in each FILE. A command-line search utility.

fields.label: Context lines
fields.tooltip: Show N lines before and after match (e.g., 3).

fields.label: Invert match (-v)
fields.tooltip: Select non-matching lines.

fields.label: Count matches (-c)
fields.tooltip: Count matching lines. Conflicts with List filenames.

fields.label: Show only filenames (-l)
fields.tooltip: Show only filenames with matches. Conflicts with Count.

fields.label: Extended regex (-E)
fields.tooltip: Use extended regular expressions.

fields.label: Pattern
fields.tooltip: The text or regular expression to search for.

fields.label: File or Path
fields.tooltip: The file or directory to search in. Leave blank for standard input.

history.description: Display the history of commands executed in the current shell session.

fields.label: Number of commands
fields.tooltip: Show last N commands (e.g., 20). Leave blank for all.

locate.description: Find files by name quickly using a database. Much faster than find.

fields.label: Limit results
fields.tooltip: Limit output to N entries (e.g., 10).

fields.label: Pattern
fields.tooltip: Filename pattern to search for (e.g., httpd.conf).

sed.description: Stream editor for filtering and transforming text.

fields.label: In-place editing (-i)
fields.tooltip: Modify file directly.

fields.label: Expression
fields.tooltip: e.g., s/old/new/g

fields.label: File
fields.tooltip: Input file. Leave blank for stdin.

whereis.description: Locate the binary, source, and manual page files for a command.

fields.label: Program name
fields.tooltip: e.g., gcc or bash

which.description: Locate a command's executable file in the user's PATH.

fields.label: Program name
fields.tooltip:
Search for installed tools, e.g.:

  Network:
    nmap, nc, tcpdump, curl, wget

  Recon/Enum:
    id, sudo, whoami, getent, groups

  Process/Utils:
    find, grep, awk, sed, gcc, make

  Exploitation:
    lsof, ss, netstat, ps, gdb, strace

  Misc:
    base64, xxd, hexdump, nano, vi
